name: @diffexai/diffex
description: Coding agent CLI with read, bash, edit, write, update_plan tools and session management

scripts.build: tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: node -e "throw new Error('Standalone distribution is deferred pending runtime redistribution review')"
scripts.copy-assets: shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/theme && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/modes/interactive/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/core/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/core/export-html/vendor/ && shx rm -rf dist/vendor && shx mkdir -p dist/vendor && shx cp -r ../harness-trace/dist dist/vendor/harness-trace && shx cp -r ../evolution/dist dist/vendor/evolution
scripts.copy-binary-assets: shx cp package.json dist/ && shx cp README.md dist/ && shx cp CHANGELOG.md dist/ && shx mkdir -p dist/theme && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html dist/export-html/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/export-html/vendor/ && node ../../scripts/copy-distribution-docs.mjs . dist && shx cp ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist/ && shx cp LICENSE THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt distribution-components.json dist/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run shrinkwrap

author: Mario Zechner
